annotations.title: Set the limits Apptiller's agent works inside

description: Sets, for one app, how far Apptiller's agent may go. Owners and admins only. Fields left out stay as they are. mode: watch (the agent only reports), ask (it proposes changes and a member approves each one; the default) or autopilot. autopilot: it applies its own proposals inside these limits by itself, two changes a day at most (where the account's plan includes it; needs a linked ad account that is being read, an attribution source, and max_daily_increase unless the budget lever is off). max_step_pct: the biggest step one change may take, 1 to 50 percent of the current bid or budget (default 20). max_daily_increase: the most one change may add to a day's budget, in the ad account's currency (null: only the percentage applies). levers: which kinds of change the agent may propose (pause, budget, bid). protected_entities: campaign, ad set or keyword ids it must never propose to change. These limits also hold when a member applies a change, from here or the dashboard: one outside them is refused.
name: set_app_limits
title: Set the limits Apptiller's agent works inside
